content: Yesuus Kiristtoosas ammanintteez wottadare maaqqith
Yikkee, ta na7ayyo, Kiristtoosa Yesuusar yez aadho kehetithyir mingoba.
Gaame markkittithar tiina taanii nena taamarsseez timirtta, hara tamaarssodayis danda7iza ammanintteez asayis hadara inggoba.
Yesuus Kiristtoosas lo77o wotaaddare maaqqii taar wolla meto ekkoba.
Wotaaddare fana azazeez fa halaqa ufayssodayis giiginttizaypp attin hara oosor fana gitooya.
Yey garkkekka, aalaalo woxxiza oonkka higgayis beeziza oger woxxaam ixxiko gamith woyito ekkooya.
Biita wootar daaburiza ooso athay fa daabura aafaypp miiz tiina as maaqqodayis beeziza.
Goday ubbabazar nees akaaka inggod gishos ta nees odeezibazana ne wozinayid naagoba.
Taanii markkattiz Wonggilay yhaya, yhayiqoppe denddeez, Dawute zerethi maaqqeez Yesuus Kiristtoosa qoppoba.
Taanii Wonggile odiza gishos daafa ootheez as garkk, accinttii meto ekkeeza. Zini Xooss qaalay accinttoya.
Yeyi gishos, Xoossii maraxeez asitay Kiristtoosa Yesuusapp dengeez atotithay baggar medhina bonchcho ekkoday garkk u gishos ubba bazar ta waayiza.
Yay garkk yeegiz qaalay ammanintteezaya;
Mino oosanchcho
Neenii unttan yhaya qopisoba; u qaalaypp dendeezayid palamaamay garkk, Xooss tiina unttan zoroba. Yeyi si7izita dhabisizapp attin akkokka maaddooya.
Neenii tuma qaala luuletithar tamaarssizannee yeellathoowa ooso as maaqqii, Xoossar dosintteez as garkk, nenatitha ees inggodayis minggoba.
Zini yha alamayis haniza maaddoowa balbuqqith odaypp haakkoba. Yey garkk oday as Xoossapp haakithiza.
Yey garkk timirttay asetithi mi haasiz citto kixxa garkke. Yey garkk oda odinttizitay ganccepp Hemenoosarannee Filixoosar yeza.
Yha asitay tuma oga ashshii, «Yhayqqeez asay yhayiqoppe binii denddeeza» yeegii pettii pettii asitay ammana dhabiseeza.
Hano zin, «Goday Ees maaqqeezita eriza» ubbarakk «Goday sunth xeegiz oonkka iita oosopp haakko» yeegiz maatamer yez eni7oowa Xooss baasay miinggii yezoda.

Pettii damma keetha worqqapp woy birapp oosintteez miishe aadda baazin mithappennee zhiice biittapp oosintteez miishitaiykka yeza. Yeyititaypp baggitay bonchcho oosos, ma baggitay tooshinttiza oosos peezhiza.
Yeyi gishos, oonkka iita ubba ashshikonnee fana geeshshiko, bonchcho ooso oothiza miishe maaqqoda. U yessay geeshshinnee Goda ufayssiz abaz, ma unttii lo77o ooso ubba oothodayis danda7izita maaqqoda.
Na7atith iita amotithappe haakkoba. Geeshsha wozinar Goda xeegiz asayir pettipp, xillotithi, ammano, siiqonnee sarotith kaalloba.
Zini kachi medhdhizana erii boozetithinnee cere palamapp haakkoba.
Goda oosanchchay as ubbayis keeha, lo77o tamaarssizannee danda7anchcho maaqqodayis beezizapp attin kaccinttodayis beezooya.
E paar eqinttizita ashikketithar seeriza maaqqodayis beeziza. Unttii fa nagaraypp maaqqii tuma eroday garkk Xoossii oothodazakko oonii ere.
Unttii fa wozinako maaqqii fa shene udod garkk unttan aykkeez Xalahe xikaypp buuttoda.
